dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit dark, irregular perimeters with sharp gradient transitions to light-toned interiors. These rings are predominantly sub-elliptical, with the most defined examples clustered on the upper-right dorsal section.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of asymmetrical white pixel clusters concentrated along the upper-mid dorsal ridge. These patches lack internal gradients or dark centers, appearing as solid-toned high-intensity interruptions in the mottled pattern.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest dorsal annuli form a scalene triangular geometry. A secondary arrangement of centroids from smaller clusters near the mid-flank forms a near-linear horizontal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly visible, fanned-out white vibrissae extending from the mystacial region, creating a high-contrast linear pattern against the dark facial pixels.
